amazigh.alt: A multi-storey stone fortified granary with small wooden windows and a central courtyard in the Anti-Atlas mountains.
amazigh.caption: The collective fortified granary (agadir) of Inoumar in Morocco's Anti-Atlas, a communal storehouse managed for centuries by Amazigh village assemblies.

fula.file: A Fulani Herders and His Herd.jpg
fula.alt: A Fulani pastoralist herding a large group of cattle across open savanna.
fula.caption: A Fulani pastoralist herding cattle, central to the seasonal transhumance and pastoral life across the West African Sahel and savanna.

yoruba.file: A crowd attending the Osun Osogbo Annual festival.jpg
yoruba.alt: A large crowd in colorful clothing gathered along a tree-lined road during the Osun-Osogbo festival.
yoruba.caption: Crowds attending the annual Osun-Osogbo festival in Osun State, Nigeria, celebrating at the sacred grove.

maasai.alt: Maasai community members in red and patterned shuka cloth performing the traditional jumping dance outdoors.
maasai.caption: Maasai community members performing the traditional jumping dance (Adumu), an expression of shared cultural ritual and community.

san.file: Khomani San people, Kalahari, Northern Cape, South Africa (20543494255).jpg
san.alt: Members of the ǂKhomani San community walking through red Kalahari dunes, examining desert plants.
san.caption: Members of the ǂKhomani San community in the southern Kalahari, sharing botanical knowledge and tracking practices passed down across generations.

oromo.alt: A large crowd gathered by the lake shore holding green grass bunches in celebration.
oromo.caption: Celebrations of Irreecha, the Oromo thanksgiving festival, at Lake Hora Arsadi in Bishoftu, Ethiopia, where millions gather annually with bunches of fresh grass (coqorsaa).
